svg.title: Merzkava Universe — World Investigation Wall
svg.desc: A wide, densely layered Reverse 1999 inspired world archive board covering the Spirit Realm, three powers, regions, characters, Spirit Beasts and Rings, history, factions, travel, economy, academies and Arcanistry.

g.text: MERZKAVA WORLD ARCHIVE / FIELD INVESTIGATION / MASTER WALL 01
THE WORLD DOES NOT FIT IN ONE FILE
Three powers · Nine Spirit Realms · countless lives, histories, beasts and unanswered questions
Cold frontier · rare metals · accepts half-beasts
BOUNDARIES / ROUTES / CLAIMS: CONSULT MAP MODULE
The map is a question, not an answer.
Cultivation, Martial Soul and Spirit Ring
progress are related — but not interchangeable.
Awakening follows the two-year cycle after New Year.
beast tier, age gap, combat difficulty and
voluntary gifting affect the final outcome.
Beyond the known band: Heaven Realm.
never generalize one profile to another.
Institutions teach through their own doctrine,
history and interests. Rival schools may distrust,
Spirit Ring formation and absorption shape
abilities; natural and aberrant expressions exist.
Qi efficiency and Sync are distinct considerations.
DOCTRINE IS PERSPECTIVE — NOT UNIVERSAL TRUTH
Surviving records are incomplete. A rumor,
a witness account and verified history are
An Ordo branch; maps ruins, verifies findings,
and pays for reliable exploration records.
A dead zone is not an invitation to assume safety.
ACADEMY ≠ AUTOMATIC ACCESS TO SPECIALIST INSTITUTE
ROUTES, TIME, COST AND RISK ARE PART OF PLAY
Thinker development is independent of cultivation.
Engravers and artificial artifacts extend capability.
THREE ORIGINS — DO NOT CONFUSE THEM
Relic · inheritance or object left by a deity
Ancient Artifact · made in a golden age
Artificial Artifact · crafted by an Arcanist
institution, not the only workshop or Arcanist.
No single capital, sect or doctrine speaks for all.
Local accounts can disagree — investigate why.

svg.text: MERZKAVA UNIVERSE / WORLD ARCHIVE / THE BOARD IS A LEAD — THE CANON FILES ARE THE EVIDENCE
BLUE + RED THREADS / CONNECTIONS, NOT PROOF
